description: cmprsk::cuminc(ftime = time, fstatus = cause, group = group, rho = 0, cencode = 0). gray_tests: one row per cause with Gray's K-sample statistic (stat), p-value (pv) and df = K - 1; gray_test(time, cause, group, cause_of_interest = c) must equal the row with cause = c. cif_by_group / cif_pooled: Aalen-Johansen CIF (right-continuous, value at each cif_grid time, i.e. including jumps at that time) from cmprsk::timepoints, with cmprsk's variance estimate (informative only).
